info.title: TokenFuse Cloud
info.description: Fleet-wide control plane: per-org spend, kill-switch and central budgets.

get.summary:
The caller org's per-agent spend rollup, highest spend first. The
empty-string agent is the unattributed bucket.
Runs at or above the alert threshold of their central budget.

parameters.name: pct
parameters.description: Budget fraction (0..1) to flag at; defaults to the server's `alert_pct`.

get.summary:
The caller org's tamper-evident audit trail of control-plane mutations,
oldest first. Readable by any role (like the other reads); a paid feature.

A cryptographically-signed manifest over the caller org's audit chain tip:
an ES256 signature (server P-256 key) an auditor can verify offline to prove
the log ended at this entry, unaltered. Readable by any role (like the other
audit reads); a paid feature. When no signing key is configured the server
returns `404 {"error":"audit manifest signing not configured"}` (never a
`500`); the rest of the audit trail is unaffected.

200.description: signed manifest over the chain tip

get.summary:
Verify the caller org's audit chain end-to-end: `{ok:true}` when intact, else
`{ok:false, break_index:N}` at the first broken link. A paid feature.
This org's run → budget-micros overrides (gateways poll this).

The caller org's compliance evidence pack: the control catalog projected
against the org's live decision + incident evidence. Readable by any role
(like the other reads); a paid feature.
get.description:
The cloud path has **incident** evidence but no **finding** evidence: MCP
scans aren't ingested to the control plane, so the findings map is empty
here. This is the exact mirror of the CLI path (`compute_compliance`), which
has scan findings but no incidents — both are honest partial views, and both
go through the same `compute_compliance_from_counts` kernel.

get.summary:
A regulator evidence pack: the org's live decision/incident/audit evidence
mapped to three external framework sections (EU AI Act, US SR 11-7
model-risk guidance, SOC 2) and honestly graded per control. A second view
over data `/v1/compliance` already exposes, never a new signal and never a
mutation; see `EvidenceStatus`'s doc for exactly how a grade is decided.
Readable by any role, like the other reads; a paid feature.

post.summary: Register a Live Activity push token for a run (device-signed).

Register/refresh a device's APNs token (device-signed; `{id}` must be the
signing device).

get.summary:
The caller org's open incidents, most-recently-seen first. Readable by any
role (viewer or admin), like the other read endpoints.

post.summary: Acknowledge an incident (admin only). Sets `acknowledged = true`.
A gateway pushes a batch of settled calls for its org.

get.summary: Run ids this org has killed (gateways poll this).

post.summary:
Redeem a pairing code with a device public key. No bearer auth — the code is
the credential. Returns the device's identity and its read token.

400.description: invalid or expired code / bad json

post.summary:
Issue a one-time pairing code (admin org key). The dashboard renders it as a
QR the app scans.

get.summary:
Replay of one run: its ordered agent-event timeline (if
`TOKENFUSE_CLOUD_REPLAY_EVENTS` is configured), joined with the run's
incidents and any audit-chain entries that reference it. `RunAgg` is an
aggregate only, with no ordered per-call list, so the timeline itself
comes from the append-only agent-event NDJSON export (see
`crate::replay`), not the in-memory store. Read-only: no enforcement or
stored state changes. A paid feature, gated like the rest of the audit
trail; the run must belong to the caller's org or this 404s (never leaks
whether a run id exists for a different org).

post.summary: Set a central budget for a run (admin only). Gateways poll `/v1/budgets`.
Mark a run killed (admin only). Gateways poll `/v1/kills` and hard-stop it.

get.summary:
The caller org's FinOps savings: budget-protection blocked (avoided) spend,
semantic-cache savings, and model-router savings, plus their total.
Burn-rate buckets over a time window — feeds the chart and the Dynamic Island.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Scope to a single run; omit for the whole org.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Time span back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `30m` (default `1h`).

run_id.description: The run this Live Activity tracks.

AgentAgg.description:
Per-agent spend rollup (P2), folded from an org's [`RunAgg`]s by `agent_id`.
The empty-string `agent_id` is kept as an explicit "unattributed" bucket.

agent_id.description: The agent this bucket rolls up; `""` for unattributed runs.

runs.description: Distinct runs attributed to this agent.

spent_microusd.description: Real spend (blocked/avoided-spend rows already excluded upstream).

Alert.description: A run that has spent at or above a fraction of its central budget.

token.description: APNs device token (hex) for push delivery.

AuditEntrySchema.description:
OpenAPI documentation mirror of `tokenfuse_core::audit::AuditEntry` — the
`/v1/audit` handler returns the core type, which serializes identically. It
lives here (rather than deriving `ToSchema` in core) to keep `tokenfuse-core`
free of the web/OpenAPI `utoipa` dependency.

AuditManifest.description:
A cryptographically-signed manifest over an org's audit chain tip. The
signature covers `tokenfuse_core::audit::manifest_signing_bytes(org,
tip_seq, tip_hash, entry_count, signed_at_millis)`; an auditor re-derives
those bytes from these fields and verifies `signature_b64` against
`public_key_b64` with any standard ES256 tool — no trust in the store
required.

algorithm.description: The signature algorithm — always `"ES256"` (ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256).

entry_count.description: Total entries in the chain at signing time (`0` for an empty chain).

org.description: The organization whose chain this manifest attests.

public_key_b64.description:
base64 (standard) of the SEC1/X9.63 *uncompressed* public point, so an
auditor can verify with any standard ECDSA tool.

signature_b64.description:
base64 (standard) of the raw 64-byte `r||s` (IEEE P1363) ES256 signature
over the canonical bytes.

signed_at_millis.description: When the manifest was signed, epoch millis. Part of the signed bytes.

tip_hash.description: The tip entry's `entry_hash` (`""` for an empty chain).

tip_seq.description: The tip entry's `seq` (`0` for an empty chain).

AuditVerifyResponse.description:
Result of an audit-chain integrity check. `ok` is `true` for an intact (or
empty) chain; otherwise `break_index` is the 0-based position of the first
broken link.

CallRecord.description:
One settled call, pushed by a gateway's `CloudSink`. The wire shape matches
`crates/gateway/src/sink.rs::CallRecord` (kept in sync by hand, exactly as
the Go plane did); a later cleanup can hoist the shared type into
`tokenfuse-core` so producer and consumer derive it from one definition.

agent_id.description:
Attribution: which logical agent made the call (P2). Accepted for
forward-compat; aggregation (/v1/agents) lands in a later PR.

on_behalf_of.description:
Raw, unparsed `X-Fuse-On-Behalf-Of` delegation chain (P3,
agent-passport SPEC.md §5). `""` when unset. Matches
`crates/gateway/src/sink.rs::CallRecord::on_behalf_of` on the wire (a
comma-separated string, not an array). Accepted for forward-compat; no
aggregation reads this field yet.

outcome.description:
Opaque outcome tag, from `X-Fuse-Outcome` (P4, unit economics). `""`
when unset. Matches `crates/gateway/src/sink.rs::CallRecord::outcome`
on the wire. Accepted for forward-compat; no aggregation reads this
field yet.

parent_run_id.description:
The run's parent, from `X-Fuse-Parent-Run-Id` (P3, agent-passport).
`""` when the run has no parent. Matches
`crates/gateway/src/sink.rs::CallRecord::parent_run_id` on the wire.
Accepted for forward-compat; no aggregation reads this field yet.

saved_microusd.description:
Cache-hit savings in microdollars (P2). Accepted for forward-compat;
aggregation (/v1/savings) lands in a later PR.

ComplianceReportSchema.description:
OpenAPI mirror of `tokenfuse_core::compliance::ComplianceReport` — the full
evidence pack returned by `/v1/compliance`. Mirrors the core shape exactly
(the handler returns the core type). `framework_versions` is a list of
`[framework_id, human_name, version_or_retrieval_date]` triples.

controls.description: Per-control realized evidence, in catalog order.

framework_versions.description:
`[framework_id, human_name, version]` triples the mappings were cited
against.

generated_note.description: Standing disclaimer — this is evidence, not a certification.

ControlEvidenceSchema.description:
OpenAPI mirror of `tokenfuse_core::compliance::ControlEvidence` — one
control's realized evidence. The `/v1/compliance` handler returns the core
type, which serializes identically; the schema lives here (not deriving
`ToSchema` in core) to keep `tokenfuse-core` free of the `utoipa` dependency.

incident_count.description: Cloud incidents aggregating into this control.

EvidenceControl.description:
One control's entry in a regulator evidence-pack framework section: the
TokenFuse control plus the external clause it is cited against, honestly
graded, and the concrete signal the grade was decided from.

EvidencePackResponse.description:
A regulator evidence pack: the same live decision/incident/audit data
behind `/v1/compliance`, additionally mapped to three external framework
sections and honestly graded per control (see `EvidenceStatus`). Read-only
and additive: this changes no stored state and does not affect
enforcement; it exists so an operator can hand a regulator a mapped,
evidence-backed view without the `/v1/compliance` contract itself moving.

audit_break_index.description:
0-based index of the first broken link, when `audit_chain_verified` is
`false`.

audit_chain_verified.description:
Whether this org's audit chain verifies end-to-end right now (see
`Store::audit_verify`).

generated_note.description:
Standing disclaimer, shared with `/v1/compliance`: evidence, not a
certification.

sr_11_7.description: US Federal Reserve SR 11-7 model-risk-management guidance.

EvidenceStatus.description:
Honesty classification for one control in the regulator evidence pack
(`/v1/compliance/evidence`), decided from THIS org's live data, not a
static catalog claim: `Enforced` only when the org has produced concrete
evidence the control fired; `Partial` when the mechanism is caveated (see
`evidence_status`) or an integrity check itself failed; `Documented`
otherwise (implemented and described, but no evidence yet for this org).
Serialized as the bare variant name (`"Enforced"` / `"Partial"` /
`"Documented"`).

Incident.description:
An aggregated, first-class anomaly for an org (P2 incidents). Repeated or
severe detections are folded into one `Incident` keyed by a STABLE
[`incident_id`] (`"{kind}:{run_or_agent}"`) so later triggers bump
`occurrences`/`last_seen_millis` in place rather than piling up duplicates.
Persisted in the snapshot so open incidents — and the push-dedup clock
(`last_notified_millis`) — survive a restart.

agent_id.description: The agent attributed at trip time, when the gateway tagged the run.

last_notified_millis.description:
Epoch millis of the last push fired for this incident — the SINGLE
source of truth for push dedup (see `push.rs`). `0` until first notified.

occurrences.description: How many times this incident's threshold has tripped.

run_id.description:
The run this incident is scoped to, if run-scoped (`spend_spike` is
org-scoped and leaves this `None`).

severity.description: Reused from `tokenfuse_core` — rendered as a lowercase string in JSON.

role.description: Role the paired device will have (`admin` | `viewer`); default `admin`.

org.description: The org that needs an upgrade.

PlanRequiredResponse.description:
Envelope for a `402 plan_required` denial from the entitlements gate. The
error is an object (not the flat string of [`ErrorResponse`]) so clients can
key an upgrade CTA off `feature`/`upgrade_url`.

ReplayEvent.description:
One parsed NDJSON line from the agent-event export.

A cloud-local mirror of `tokenfuse_core::agent_event::AgentEvent`'s wire
shape, not the core type itself: that struct derives `Serialize` only (no
`Deserialize`), and keeping this mirror here also matches this repo's rule
that core types reach the Cloud API surface only via cloud-local DTOs.

Every field is best-effort (`#[serde(default)]`), so an envelope from an
older or newer schema revision still parses; only a line that isn't even a
valid JSON object counts as malformed (see `read_run_events`).

audit.description:
Audit-chain entries whose subject is this run (e.g. kills, budget
changes), oldest first.

configured.description:
Whether `TOKENFUSE_CLOUD_REPLAY_EVENTS` is configured on this server
(independent of whether any events matched this run).

malformed_skipped.description:
NDJSON lines in the configured file that failed to parse (skipped, not
counted as this run's events).

RunAgg.description: The aggregated state of one run within an organization.

agent_id.description:
Which logical agent this run is attributed to (P2). Empty when the
gateway didn't tag the calls — folded into the "unattributed" bucket by
[`Store::agents`]. `serde(default)` so pre-P2 snapshots still load.

SavingsSummary.description:
Per-org FinOps savings summary (P2). `total_saved_microusd` is the marketing
headline: budget-protection blocked spend plus semantic-cache savings plus
model-router savings.

blocked_spend_microusd.description: Avoided spend from budget-protection blocks (runaway spend stopped).

budget_breaks.description: Distinct runs stopped by at least one budget-protection block.

cache_saved_microusd.description: Dollars served for free by the semantic cache.

router_saved_microusd.description:
Dollars avoided by the model router routing a call to a cheaper model
than the one requested. A distinct dimension from `cache_saved_microusd`
even though both ride the same wire `saved_microusd` column: a cache
hit and a router-routed call are mutually exclusive outcomes for one
call (see the fold in `ingest_at`).

SeriesBucket.description: One time bucket of the burn-rate series.

Summary.description:
Org-wide totals. `calls`/`spent_microusd` are exact across the org's
entire ingest history; `runs` is the currently-retained distinct run
count, bounded by `MAX_RUNS_PER_ORG` — see `Store::summary`.
